title: Beginner Friendly Stand Up Paddleboarding Class in Virginia Beach
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Learn the basics of stand-up paddle boarding with an introduction to SUP 101 designed for beginners and all skill levels. This 1.5-hour class covers board orientation, paddle stroke skills, turns, and a guided tour while providing the board, paddle, and life jacket. The class takes place primarily in Virginia Beach and Chesapeake, with the location subject to change based on environmental conditions. Certified instructors provide practical guidance to help participants build confidence and enjoy time outside on the water.
